parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is the main structural frame of the cabinet made of plywood, providing support and housing for other components.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the cabinet doors, shelves, and decorations, maintaining the overall shape and stability of the furniture.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part that serves as the base structure for the entire cabinet.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: This is the cabinet door made of solid wood, attached to the frame with hinges or sliding mechanisms.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the storage compartments inside the cabinet and protects the contents from dust and damage.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate or slide depending on the hinge or track mechanism, enabling opening and closing motion.

parts.name: Rectangular Decoration (Other)
parts.Basic_description: This is a decorative rectangular panel made of MDF, attached to the cabinet for aesthetic enhancement.
parts.Functional_description: It serves a decorative purpose, improving the visual appeal of the cabinet without affecting its structural integrity.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part that remains attached to the cabinet frame.
